target_customer: Knowledge workers such as founders, consultants, investors and analysts who want multi-agent AI research and deliverables
problem: Single chat threads handle complex work poorly. Spine gives a visual canvas where many agents plan and execute in parallel with human oversight.
business_model: SaaS subscription for Canvas, with a local first orchestrator product (Medley)
product_category: AI agent orchestration / visual AI workspace

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating many models and agents on a collaborative canvas is standard product engineering around foundation models, with hard parts in agent reliability.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third party models, and canvas plus agent interfaces are easy for model labs, Miro and others to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model labs and workspace tools added agent and canvas features; no acquisition of Spine was found.
